_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feature_flag" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profile" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "age_range" TEXT NULL, "activity_level" TEXT NULL, "primary_height_id" TEXT NULL, "goal_weight_min_kg" REAL NULL, "goal_weight_max_kg" REAL NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gender" TEXT NULL, "diet_preference" TEXT NULL, "style_fit" TEXT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "height_record" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "lower_bound" REAL NULL, "upper_bound" REAL NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_record" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "lower_bound" REAL NULL, "upper_bound" REAL NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurement" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "lower_bound" REAL NULL, "upper_bound" REAL NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "lower_bound" REAL NULL, "upper_bound" REAL NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "food" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NULL, "calories" REAL NULL, "eaten_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wake_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "steps" INTEGER NULL, "distance_km" REAL NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_session" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sets" INTEGER NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "performed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_completion" ("habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES habit (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("habit_id", "day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekdays" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_item" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routine (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "minute_of_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "reminder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("reminder" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_completion" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routine_item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "rescheduled_minute" INTEGER NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "posture_session" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "view" TEXT NOT NULL, "frames_used" INTEGER NOT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" REAL NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "posture_metric" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES posture_session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "metric" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "band" TEXT NOT NULL, "spread" REAL NOT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "metric"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "face_analysis" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shape" TEXT NOT NULL, "also_like" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL, "frames_used" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "face_metric" ("analysis_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES face_analysis (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "metric" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("analysis_id", "metric"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hairstyle_favorite" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "progress_snapshot" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "jpeg" BLOB NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "left_eye_x" REAL NULL, "left_eye_y" REAL NULL, "right_eye_x" REAL NULL, "right_eye_y" REAL NULL, "align_checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("align_checked" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wardrobe_item" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "formality" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occasions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "photo" BLOB NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outfit" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occasion" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outfit_item" ("outfit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES outfit (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wardrobe_item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("outfit_id", "item_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outfit_wear" ("outfit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES outfit (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("outfit_id", "day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_plan" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "pace" TEXT NOT NULL, "diet" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL, "protein_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "carbs_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fat_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "water_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mood_log" ("day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mood" INTEGER NOT NULL, "energy" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("day"));
CREATE INDEX idx_height_recorded_at ON height_record (recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_weight_recorded_at ON weight_record (recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_measurement_type_recorded_at ON body_measurement (type, recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_water_recorded_at ON water_log (recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_meal_eaten_at ON meal (eaten_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_sleep_wake_at ON sleep_log (wake_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_activity_recorded_at ON activity_log (recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_performed_at ON exercise_session (performed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_habit_completion_day ON habit_completion (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_routine_item_routine ON routine_item (routine_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_plan_record_day ON routine_completion (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_posture_session_recorded_at ON posture_session (recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_face_analysis_recorded_at ON face_analysis (recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_snapshot_kind_taken ON progress_snapshot (kind, taken_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_wardrobe_category ON wardrobe_item (category)
